# Out-of-note reference marks

Original OPC/XML controls generated by `tools/inactive_note_marks_fixture.py`.
There are no actual notes, note references, macros, or third-party document assets.
The reference application opened each file and exported its PDF without saving the source.
`tools/record_inactive_note_marks.py` binds source/PDF hashes and extracted text
in `reference.json`.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.11.6 and 17.11.13 allow `endnoteRef` and `footnoteRef` to be
ignored outside the corresponding note. **Reference compatibility choice:** the reference application
instead displays ordinal one for both mark kinds. Both use the footnote format,
even when the endnote format differs; neither uses the configured `numStart`.
This is a choice where the standard permits ignoring, not a mandatory-rule
violation. These marks are distinct from `footnoteReference`/`endnoteReference`,
which point to actual notes and remain unsupported for editing.

Controls include same-run boundaries, separate large bold red superscript runs,
adjacent marks in an otherwise empty paragraph, and a table cell. Generate the
numbering variants with `--format upperRoman` and `--format decimalZero`: both
set footnote start 7 and endnote start 3/lowerLetter, while the reference application prints I or 01.
`--literal` replaces each mark with ordinary `1` text under identical formatting.

The app retains each mark's element identity, displays its value, and treats a
multi-character value as one editable object. Formatting preserves the element;
replacement creates ordinary text. No-edit package preservation, neighbor edits,
exact undo, formatting, search, deletion and export/reopen are tested.

The former 5.28pt-per-mark displacement is corrected. The independent
`note-mark-metrics` matrix proves it came from automatic additional leading,
not a smaller natural descent: The reference application excludes note marks from the metrics used
for the line-spacing multiplier. The native and app full-page pair was inspected
after correction. Font-dependent superscript ink sizing remains unresolved;
this control is **not** claimed visually complete.
